description: LISTAGG semantics: the delimiter defaults to the EMPTY string (Snowflake, not a comma), the optional second argument sets an explicit delimiter - previously dropped, because the executor treated it as a second column and aggregated the wrong one - and a comma INSIDE the delimiter literal survives the value/delimiter split. NULLs are skipped, numeric values are stringified, it applies per group when grouped, and WITHIN GROUP reorders the values rather than concatenating them as scanned. Converted 1:1 from functions/ListAggTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach la fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v) AS r FROM la
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v, '|') AS r FROM la
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v, ', ') AS r FROM la
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v, '|') AS r FROM la WHERE k = 2
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(k, '-') AS r FROM la
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT k, LISTAGG(v, '-') AS r FROM la GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) AS r FROM la
CREATE TABLE la (k INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO la VALUES (1, 'a'), (1, 'b'), (2, 'c'), (2, NULL)
SELECT LISTAGG(v, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v DESC) AS r FROM la
